blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: While recent video foundation models excel at generating high-quality short videos, long-form video generation remains challenging because independently generated shots must preserve consistent characters, scenes, and objects throughout a story. Existing training-free approaches typically condition target shots using retrieved historical visuals. However, these references often suffer from severe informational mismatch, either introducing irrelevant contextual redundancy or failing to provide the complete set of elements required for the target shot. To resolve this, we present Complementary Retrieval-Augmented Prompting, an agentic framework that strategically aggregates a compact set of mutually supportive historical references to achieve complete and targeted conditioning for long-form video generation without retraining or modifying the underlying generator. Specifically, our framework explicitly models the visual elements required by each target shot by parsing the narrative script into a text-grounded visual element registry that tracks characters, objects, scenes, and their shot-level states. A VLM-annotated keyframe library further maps these elements to past visual observations. Guided by the required elements, our agent retrieves complementary references that maximize target-element coverage while minimizing historical noise. Finally, the retrieved references, structured element states, and grounding instructions are assembled into a unified prompt for the frozen video generator. This element-aware process provides comprehensive conditioning while remaining fully interpretable. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations on multi-shot story generation demonstrate improved cross-shot character, object, and scene consistency over memory-based and agentic retrieval baselines.
blocks.zh: 虽然近期的视频基础模型在生成高质量的短视频方面表现出色,但长式视频生成仍然具有挑战性,因为独立生成的镜头必须在整个故事中保留一致的角色,场景和物品. 现有的无培训方法通常会利用收回的历史视觉来限制目标拍摄。 然而,这些参考文献往往存在严重的信息错配,要么引入无关紧要的背景冗余,要么无法提供目标拍摄所需的全套要素. 为了解决这个问题,我们提出了补充检索强化提示,这是一种代理框架,它从战略上汇集了一整套相互支持的历史参考材料,以便在不进行再培训或修改基本生成器的情况下,为长式视频生成实现完整和有针对性的条件。 具体地说,我们的框架明确模拟每个目标拍摄所需的视觉元素,将叙述脚本解析成一个以文字为底线的视觉元素登记册,以跟踪字符,物体,场景,以及他们的镜头级别状态. 一个VLM附加说明的密钥框架库进一步将这些元素映射到过去的视觉观测. 在所需要素的指导下,我们的代理人检索到补充参考文献,以最大限度地扩大目标要素覆盖面,同时尽量减少历史噪音。 最后,检索到的参考文献、结构化元素状态和地平面指示被集合成一个统一的被冻结的视频生成器的提示。 这一元素意识过程提供了全面的条件,同时仍然可以充分解释。 对多镜头故事生成的定量和定性评价显示,比起基于内存和代理检索基线,交叉镜头的特性、对象和场景一致性得到了改进。

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent video foundation models can synthesize visually rich short clips from text, images, videos, and other multimodal prompts ( Gao et al. 2025 ; Kling Team 2025 ; Huang et al. 2025 ; Bao et al. 2024 ; Alibaba Cloud 2025 ; Google DeepMind 2025 ) . Rather than training a specialized long-video model, creators can decompose a story into shots, generate each shot with an off-the-shelf reference-conditioned model, and assemble the resulting clips into a complete narrative. This shot-by-shot workflow is already widely used in the production of short dramas and motion comics because it is flexible, interpretable, and compatible with rapidly evolving commercial video APIs.
blocks.zh: 近期的视频基础模型可以从文本,图像,视频等多模式提示中合成视觉丰富的短片(Gao等. 2025;克林队 2025;黄等. 2025; Bao等 2024; Alibaba Cloud 2025; Google DeepMind 2025 (英语). 创作者们与其训练出专门的长视频模型,不如把一个故事分解成镜头,用现成的参考条件模型生成出每个镜头,并把产生的片段组装成完整的叙事. 这种逐一拍摄的工作流程已经在制作短剧和动作漫画时被广泛使用,因为它具有灵活性,可被解释性,并能与快速演变的商业视频API相兼容.

blocks.en: However, long-form generation is not simply a matter of stitching short clips together. When each shot is generated independently, recurring characters may drift in appearance, objects may disappear or change shape, and scenes may be reintroduced with inconsistent layouts ( Zhang et al. 2025 ; He et al. 2026 ) . Reference images and videos can mitigate these issues, but they also introduce a new bottleneck: before generating each shot, the system must decide which historical references are useful, which visual elements in those references should be preserved, and which stale elements should be suppressed. In practice, this reference selection and prompt construction process is still largely manual, especially when multiple characters, objects, and locations recur over long temporal gaps.
blocks.zh: 然而,长形相代不仅仅是将短片缝合在一起的问题. 每次拍摄独立产生时,反复出现的人物可能外观会漂移,物体会消失或会改变形状,场景可能会以不一致的布局重新出现(张等2025;贺等2026). 参考图像和视频可以缓解这些问题,但是它们也引入了一个新的瓶颈:在生成出每个镜头之前,系统必须决定哪些历史参考是有用的,这些参考中哪些视觉元素应当被保留,哪些僵化元素应当被压制. 在实践中,这种参考选择和即时构建过程基本上仍然是人工的,特别是在多个字符,对象和位置在长时间的空白中再起的情况下.

blocks.en: Existing long-form video methods address consistency from different directions, but they leave this reference-management problem underexplored for frozen multimodal video generators. Training-based approaches propagate memory through attention, caches, latent retrieval, or learned conditioning ( Meng et al. 2026 ; Wu et al. 2025b ; An et al. 2026 ; Luo et al. 2026 ; Zhang et al. 2025 ; Wei et al. 2026 ; Hu et al. 2026 ) , which often incur high computational overhead and lack scalability. Agentic and explicit-memory pipelines improve controllability by maintaining scripts, entities, or generated keyframes ( Lin et al. 2024 ; Zheng et al. 2024 ; Wu et al. 2025a ; Huang et al. 2026 ; Liu et al. 2026 ; Zhou et al. 2026 ; Yin et al. 2026 ; Lai et al. 2026 ) , but they often rely on predefined full-script analysis, entity-level canonical references, or manually designed prompt/reference layouts. These designs are powerful, yet less suited to incremental and interactive creation where users may extend or revise the story while generation proceeds.
blocks.zh: 现有的长式视频方法从不同方向解决一致性问题,但它们没有为被冻结的多式视频发电机对这个参考管理问题进行充分探讨. 基于培训的方法通过注意、缓存、潜在检索或学习条件来传播记忆(Meng等)。 2026; 吴等. (原始内容存档于2025b; An等2026; Luo等. 2026; 张等. 2025; 韦等. 2026; Hu等 2026),经常发生高计算间接费用并缺乏可扩展性. 通过维持脚本、实体或生成的键框(Lin等),代理式和显式式管线提高了可控性。 2024; 郑等. 2024; 吴等. 2025a; 黄等. 2026; 刘等. 2026; 周等编. 2026; 殷等. 2026; Lai等 2026),但他们经常依赖于预先定义的全写分析,实体级的犬科参考,或手动设计的即时/参考布局. 这些设计很强大,但不太适合渐进和互动的创建,用户可以在生成的同时扩展或修改故事。

blocks.en: We propose Complementary Retrieval-Augmented Prompting , an agentic framework that treats long-form video generation as an interpretable retrieval and multimodal prompting problem. The agent maintains two evolving evidence structures. First, a text-grounded visual element registry tracks characters, objects, and scenes introduced by the script, together with shot-level states such as should-reference, should-exclude, optional, and newly introduced. Second, a VLM-annotated keyframe library records where these elements appear in generated shots, using both element-level annotations and holistic frame descriptions. Given a new shot, the agent retrieves a compact set of complementary historical keyframes that jointly cover the required visual elements while penalizing references that may introduce conflicting content. These selected references are then converted into a structured multimodal prompt that explicitly explains how each image should be used or avoided by the frozen generator.
blocks.zh: 我们提议补充检索-强化提示(Attraval-Auguped Pointing),这是一个代理框架,将长式视频生成视为可解释的检索和多模式引发的问题。 该代理人维持两个演变中的证据结构。 首先,一个以文字为底的可视元素注册跟踪脚本引入的字符,对象,和场景,加上shot-level状态,如should-reference,should-排斥,可选,以及新引入等. 其次,一个VLM-附加说明的键框库记录,其中这些元素出现在生成的镜头中,同时使用元素级说明和整体帧描述. 由于有了新的镜头,特工人员取回了一套紧凑的辅助历史关键框架,这些关键框架共同涵盖必要的视觉要素,同时惩罚可能引入相冲突内容的引用. 这些选定的引用随后被转换成结构化的多模式提示,明确解释被冻结的生成器如何使用或避免每个图像.

blocks.en: This formulation has two practical advantages. First, it makes reference usage explainable: each selected frame can be traced to the visual elements it covers and the risks it may introduce. Second, it supports online and interactive generation: the registry and keyframe library are updated after each generated shot, so the system does not require a complete script or a fixed generation schedule in advance. Long-range visual consistency is handled by retrieval over historical evidence, while local temporal continuity between non-cut shots can be handled separately through proximal video references and lightweight boundary smoothing.
blocks.zh: 这种提法有两个实际的优点. 首先,它使参考用法可以解释:每个被选择的框架可以被追溯到它覆盖的视觉元素和它可能带来的风险. 其次,它支持在线和交互生成:注册和密钥帧库在每次生成镜头后都会被更新,因此系统不需要一个完整的脚本或一个固定的生成时间表提前. 远程视觉一致性通过历史证据的检索处理,而非剪接镜头之间的局部时间连续性可以通过近相视频参考和轻量级边界平滑处理而单独处理.

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: • We introduce a training-free, online framework that maintains a visual element registry and a VLM-annotated keyframe library, turning generated history into structured and editable evidence without requiring the full script in advance. • We formulate reference selection as a complementary coverage problem and develop a greedy retrieval algorithm that selects compact historical references covering target elements while suppressing conflicting content. • We ground each retrieved frame through element-level and holistic guidance in a structured multimodal prompt. Experiments on EntityBench demonstrate improved cross-shot consistency over training-based methods and explicit workflow baselines.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献有三: 我们采用一个免费培训的在线框架,保持一个视觉要素登记册和一个VLM附加说明的密钥框架库,将生成的历史变成有条理和可编辑的证据,而无需提前完整脚本。 我们制定参考选择,将其作为一个补充覆盖问题,并开发出一种贪婪的检索算法,该算法在抑制内容相冲突的同时,选择涵盖目标要素的紧凑的历史参考。 我们通过元素一级和整体性的指导,在结构化的多式速报下,为每个回收的框架铺平了道路。 关于实体奔驰的实验表明,与基于培训的方法和明确的工作流程基线相比,交叉射击的一致性有所提高。

blocks.en: Related Work
blocks.zh: 相关工作

blocks.en: Training-based Long-Form Video Generation
blocks.zh: 基于培训的长格式视频生成

blocks.en: Training-based methods embed cross-shot consistency into the generator itself. HoloCine ( Meng et al. 2026 ) and CineTrans ( Wu et al. 2025b ) jointly generate multiple shots and leverage cross-shot attention to preserve visual consistency, while autoregressive and memory-based approaches propagate selected frames, feature caches, attention sinks, reconstructed subjects, or retrieved latents across generation steps ( An et al. 2026 ; Luo et al. 2026 ; Zhang et al. 2025 ; Wei et al. 2026 ; Chen et al. 2026 ; Hu et al. 2026 ) . Although effective, these mechanisms require model-specific training or access to internal representations, limiting both their portability across video generators and the interpretability of their historical conditioning.
blocks.zh: 基于训练的方法将交叉射击的一致性嵌入生成器本身. HoloCine (Meng等,2026年)和CineTrans (Wu等,2025年b)联合产生多镜头并发挥跨镜头的注意来保持视觉一致性,而自旋和基于记忆的方法则传播了所选帧,特征缓存,注意力下沉,被重建对象,或跨生成步骤取回的潜伏(An等. 2026; 罗等. 2026; 张等. 2025; 韦等. 2026; 陈等. 2026; 胡等 第2026页. 这些机制虽然有效,但需要针对具体模型的培训或内部表述,限制其跨视频生成器的可移动性及其历史条件的可解释性。

blocks.en: Explicit and Agentic Long-Form Generation
blocks.zh: 明确和代理的长形式

blocks.en: Agentic pipelines organize existing generators through script decomposition, shot planning, context allocation, and iterative visual feedback ( Lin et al. 2024 ; Zheng et al. 2024 ; Wu et al. 2025a ; Huang et al. 2026 ; Liu et al. 2026 ) . Entity-centric systems further maintain explicit states for recurring characters, objects, and scenes ( Zhou et al. 2026 ; Yin et al. 2026 ) . Meanwhile, reference-conditioned generators such as Seedance, Kling-Omni, Step-Video, and Vidu support multimodal prompting over text, images, and videos ( Gao et al. 2025 ; Kling Team 2025 ; Huang et al. 2025 ; Bao et al. 2024 ) , but long-form workflows still rely heavily on manual reference selection and prompting. GroundShot ( Lai et al. 2026 ) reduces this burden by analyzing the full script, scheduling entity-reference shots first, and grounding subsequent shots on the resulting entity memory, but still relies on a predefined complete generation task.
blocks.zh: 干线管通过脚本分解,拍摄规划,上下文分配,以及迭接视觉反馈,来组织现有的发电机(Lin等. 2024; 郑等. 2024; 吴等. 2025a; 黄等. 2026; 刘等 2026 (中文(简体) ). 以实体为中心的系统进一步对反复出现的字符,对象和场景保持了明确的状态(周等. 2026; 殷等. 2026 (中文(简体) ). 与此同时,种子、克林-奥姆尼、Step-Video和Vidu等具有参考条件的发电机支持多模式推动文字、图像和视频(Gao等人,第3段)。 2025;克林队 2025;黄等. 2025; Bao等 2024),但长式工作流程仍然严重依赖人工参考选择和提示. 地面 Shot (Lai等2026)通过分析完整脚本,先排出实体参考镜头,再将后续镜头打入所生成的实体内存来减轻了这一负担,但仍依赖于预先定义的完整生成任务.

blocks.en: Our framework instead supports incremental creation without a complete script or predefined generation order. It treats generated keyframes as VLM-annotated evidence, retrieves complementary frames under a limited reference budget, and explicitly grounds how each frame should be used while suppressing obsolete or conflicting content. This yields an interpretable and model-agnostic interface for frozen multimodal video generators.
blocks.zh: 我们的框架反而支持没有完整的脚本或预定义的生成顺序的递增创建. 它将生成的关键框架作为VLM附加说明的证据,在有限的参考预算下检索补充框架,并明确说明在压制过时或相冲突的内容的同时如何使用每个框架。 这为被冻结的多式录像发电机提供了可解释和模型不可识别的界面。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of Complementary Retrieval-Augmented Prompting. An LLM updates the visual element registry and shot-level plan; greedy coverage retrieves complementary keyframes from the VLM-annotated library; and a second LLM produces per-reference guidance for structured prompting. After generation, representative frames are mined and annotated before the library is updated. The dashed arrow denotes retrieval from the updated library for the next shot.
blocks.zh: 图1:补充检索-强化提示概述。 一个LLM更新了视觉元素注册和相片级计划;贪婪的覆盖从VLM-附加说明的库中取回了互补的密钥框架;第二个LLM为结构化的提示生成了每个参考的指南. 生成后,在更新库前会挖掘和注释代表性框架. 破折的箭头表示从更新的库取回,供下个镜头使用.

blocks.en: Method
blocks.zh: 方法

blocks.en: Overview
blocks.zh: 概览

blocks.en: We study long-form story video generation by leveraging the exceptional visual quality and robust physical modeling capabilities of frozen short-video generators. Given a narrative script decomposed into a sequence of T T shots 𝒮 = { s 1 , … , s T } \mathcal{S}=\{s_{1},\ldots,s_{T}\} , each shot s t s_{t} is generated through an independent inference call, and the generator retains no internal memory across shots. The central challenge is how to strategically construct a targeted multimodal prompt with historical references to preserve the consistency of characters, objects, and scenes across shots. To address this challenge, we present Complementary Retrieval-Augmented Prompting , an agentic framework designed to strategically orchestrate inference-stage historical conditioning. Instead of relying on passive, recency-biased retrieval, our method formalizes reference selection as an optimization problem where historical frames are selected if and only if they collectively maximize the coverage of the target shot’s required elements while minimizing informational redundancy. Under this formulation, an agent continuously tracks structured visual evidence and retrieves a compact set of complementary historical references to drive the generation loop. As illustrated in Figure 1 , our framework consists of four sequential modules: 1. Narrative-Grounded Element Registry: Parses the narrative script into a structured registry tracking required elements and their shot-level states. 2. Element-Linked Keyframe Library: Employs a VLM to annotate and index representative historical keyframes, establishing explicit cross-modal mappings for a high-diversity candidate reference pool. 3. Element-Aware Complementary Retrieval: Executes a strategic agentic search to select a minimal, mutually supportive subset of historical references that covers target elements. 4. Unified Prompt Assembly: Compiles the retrieved references, structured states, and grounding instructions into a cohesive prompt for the frozen generator.
blocks.zh: 我们通过利用冷冻短视频发电机的超乎寻常的视觉质量和强大的物理建模能力来研究长式故事视频生成. 由于一个叙事脚本分解成T T shots S = { s 1, ..., s T }\ mathcal{ S}=\{ s_{ s_{ 1},\ ldots, s_{t}\} s}\} s_{t}] 的序列,每发 s shot s  s_{ s_{t}] 是通过一个独立的推论来生成的,生成器没有内存保留到相片之间. 中心挑战是如何从战略上构建一个具有历史参考的有针对性的多模式提示,以保持人物、物体和场景在镜头中的一致性。 为了应对这一挑战,我们提出补充性补偿-强化激励框架,这是一个旨在战略性地协调推断阶段历史条件的代理框架。 我们的方法不是依赖被动的、对惯性有偏见的检索,而是将参考选择正规化为一个优化问题,即如果并且只有在选择历史框架时集体最大限度地扩大目标拍摄所需内容的覆盖面,同时尽量减少信息冗余,才会选择历史框架。 在这种提法下,一剂持续地跟踪结构化的视觉证据并取出一套紧凑的互补历史参考,以驱动生成回路. 如图1所示,我们的框架包括四个相继模块: 1. 叙述式全方位要素登记册:将叙述式脚本分解为结构化的登记册跟踪所需要素及其射入水平状态。 2. 要素链接关键框架 图书馆:使用VLM对具有代表性的历史关键框架进行注释和索引,为高度多样性候选参考库建立明确的跨模式绘图。 3. 补充要素 检索 : 执行战略代理搜索,以选择包含目标元素的最小,相互支持的历史参考子集. 4. 统一快速集会: 将检索到的参考文献、结构化状态和定位指令编成一个用于被冻结的生成器的一致的提示。

blocks.en: We represent each shot s t s_{t} as a four-field configuration tuple: s t = ( p t , d t , c t , r t ) , s_{t}=(p_{t},d_{t},c_{t},r_{t}), (1) where p t p_{t} is the foundational text prompt directing scenes, characters, and actions, and d t d_{t} denotes the target clip duration. blocks.zh: 元素链接密钥框架库

blocks.en: To establish a structured and queryable visual memory, our framework constructs an Element-Linked Keyframe Library ℒ = { f k } k = 1 M t \mathcal{L}=\{f_{k}\}_{k=1}^{M_{t}} , where M t M_{t} is the number of historical keyframes available before generating shot s t s_{t} . The library establishes explicit cross-modal mappings to the active registry ℛ \mathcal{R} . Rather than compressing historical video dynamics into holistic visual embeddings, the agent dynamically appends informative instances to ℒ \mathcal{L} , forming a high-diversity candidate reference pool for downstream complementary matching.

blocks.en: Inspired by the visual caching philosophies in StoryMem ( Zhang et al. 2025 ) , we store representative keyframes as reusable references. However, to preserve fine-grained asset diversity for subsequent complementary retrieval, our framework executes a deliberately relaxed caching protocol via a two-stage sequential gate: 1. Fidelity Filtering: Candidate frames from the newly synthesized clip are first evaluated via HPSv3 ( Ma et al. 2025 ) . Visually degraded, blurred, or artifact-heavy frames are discarded to ensure reference quality. 2. Temporal Drift Detection: For the remaining candidate pool, we compute semantic cosine distance using CLIP image features ( Radford et al. 2021 ) . A qualified frame is committed to ℒ \mathcal{L} as a new keyframe f k f_{k} if and only if its similarity to the immediately preceding accepted keyframe within the same shot falls below a specific threshold, signaling a distinct transition in the visual state. By comparing frames only with local within-shot history rather than performing aggressive global cross-shot deduplication, this protocol preserves diverse visual perspectives and gives the downstream retriever richer choices.

blocks.en: Standard similarity-based Top- K K retrieval ( Hu et al. 2026 ; An et al. 2026 ; Wei et al. 2026 ) frequently selects redundant historical frames depicting identical salient elements, leaving other critical story elements uncovered while compounding historical noise. To circumvent this, we formalize reference selection as a complementary coverage problem , seeking a compact subset of keyframes that collectively maximizes target-element coverage while systematically suppressing contextual leakage.

blocks.en: The selected historical evidence, structured element states, and textual instructions are compiled into a unified multimodal prompt to provide explicit, grounded conditioning for the frozen video generator.

blocks.en: To prevent ambiguous interpretation of the attached references, our framework enforces a structured prompt layout consisting of five functional blocks: (i) current generation task , (ii) prefix story context , (iii) shot-level element states ( 𝐘 t \mathbf{Y}_{t} ), (iv) per-reference grounding instructions , and (v) global generation constraints .

blocks.en: This architecture converts raw reference pixels into explicit, verifiable generation boundaries. Because a historical keyframe can simultaneously depict a required element and an obsolete asset, the prompt explicitly delineates both positive reference guidance and negative suppression boundaries. Element-level instructions specify which characters, objects, and scenes should be preserved or suppressed, while holistic descriptions 𝐃 k \mathbf{D}_{k} and reference guidance provide sequence-level semantic coordination.

blocks.en: System Properties: Interpretability and Editability
blocks.zh: 系统属性:可解释性和可编辑性

blocks.en: Unlike opaque, end-to-end multi-shot video generation pipelines, our element-aware framework exposes explicit structural reasoning artifacts at every stage, including shot-level element states ( 𝐘 t \mathbf{Y}_{t} ), retrieved complementary reference subsets ( S S ), the covered-element set ( C C ), grounded multimodal prompts, and keyframe annotations ( 𝐀 k \mathbf{A}_{k} ). This granular transparency directly yields three critical architectural advantages:
blocks.zh: 与不透明、从端到端的多镜头视频生成管道不同,我们的元素意识框架在每一个阶段都暴露出明确的结构推理文物,包括射级元素状态(Y t\ mathbf{Y}_{t}),检索到的补充参考子集(S S),被覆盖元素集(C C),被嵌入式多模式提示和关键框架说明(A k\ mathb{A}_{k}). 这种颗粒透明直接产生三个关键的建筑优势:

blocks.en: • Attributable Diagnosis: Generative failures become systematically traceable and diagnosable. For instance, if an obsolete element or a mismatched character identity leaks into a target shot, the user or agent can isolate whether the anomaly stems from agentic element tracking, complementary reference retrieval, or unified prompt assembly. • Auto-Reflectivity: The explicit symbolic boundaries enable autonomous self-reflection and pre-generation verification. The orchestration agent can inspect its reference-coverage matrix, evaluate constraint adherence before invoking the frozen generator, and iteratively refine instructions to maximize target-element fidelity. • Human-in-the-Loop Editability: By modularizing the narrative pipeline into human-interpretable intermediate states, our framework supports manual intervention at runtime. A human director can edit the active element registry, modulate constraint vectors, or replace retrieved references to guide story progression through a controllable and iteratively refinable generation loop.
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 分解性诊断:遗传性故障成为系统可追踪和可诊断的. 例如,如果一个过时的元素或不匹配的字符身份泄露到目标镜头中,用户或代理人可以隔离异常是否源于代理元素跟踪,互补的参考检索,或统一的即时组装. 二. 支助 自动反射 : 明确的符号边界可以实现自主自反和出厂前的验证. 管弦乐器可以检查其参考覆盖矩阵,在使用被冻结的生成器之前评价遵守约束的情况,并反复地完善指令以最大限度地实现目标忠实。 • 人行道 可编辑性 : 通过将叙事管道模块化为人可解释的中间状态,我们的框架支持在运行时进行人工干预。 人类导演可以编辑活性元素的注册,调制约束向量,或者替换被检索的引用,通过可控和可迭代可变的生成回路来引导故事的发展.

blocks.en:
We adopt the Cross-Shot Consistency evaluation from EntityBench ( He et al. 2026 ) , which measures whether recurring characters, objects, and scenes remain consistent across shots. It combines two complementary protocols. First, DINOv2 embedding similarity compares character and object appearances with their per-entity centroids, while a transition-boundary metric measures continuity across scene-internal cuts. Second, LLM pairwise judging compares each non-anchor appearance with a centroid-representative anchor using type-specific criteria, reporting both accuracy and fine-grained similarity; locations are evaluated from full frames with camera-invariant instructions to accommodate viewpoint changes and partial views. The 21 metrics are grouped into DINOv2 Similarity (3), LLM Characters (6), LLM Objects (6), and LLM Scenes (6), with Overall denoting their mean.
EntityBench additionally reports intra-shot metrics including quality and prompt following, which we omit as they

reference construction.

blocks.en: Dataset construction and generation. EntityBench contains 140 long-range multi-shot episodes. We use an LLM to filter scripts with obvious copyright or sensitive-content risks, yielding 105 eligible episodes, and randomly sample 20 Easy, 10 Mid, and 5 Hard episodes as our test set. Every shot is generated at 480P for 5 seconds. To comply with the moderation constraints of Seedance 2.0, all methods prepend the same instruction requiring non-photorealistic 2D animated human faces and original, non-copyrighted character designs. No predefined character sheets or external reference images are supplied; all visual evidence is generated from the script during inference.

blocks.en: Method-specific implementation. All explicit workflows use their default reference-construction procedures with Seedance 2.0 as the common video backend. ViMax and VideoMemory use Seedream 5.0 to synthesize their dedicated entity references. Training-based baselines use the released pretrained weights and repository-default inference settings on an NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU. For a fair StoryMem reproduction, we preserve its original keyframe maintenance policy but adapt its 3 Sink + 7 Recent budget to 3 Sink + 6 Recent because Seedance 2.0 accepts at most nine images. Our method retrieves at most five historical frames per shot. Its element weights are 3.0, 2.0, and 1.5 for characters, scenes, and objects; uncovered and covered required elements receive weights 1.0 and 0.2, optional elements 0.1, and excluded elements − 0.1 -0.1 . The corresponding reference-quality weights for full, partial, and weak evidence are 1.0, 0.2, and 0.1.
blocks.zh: 具体方法的执行。 所有明确的工作流程都使用以"种子2.0"为常见视频后端的默认参考构建程序. ViMax和VideoMemory使用"Seedream 5.0"合成其专用实体参考. 基于培训的基线在NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU上使用释放的预受训练重量和寄存器-默认推断设置. 为了公平的StoryMem复制,我们保留其最初的关键框架维护政策,但调整其3 Sink + 7 最近的预算为3 Sink + 6 最近,因为种子2.0最多接受9个图像。 我们的方法以每发最多5个历史帧取回. 其元素权重为3.0,2.0,而人物,场景和物体为1.5;被破获并被覆盖的所需元素得到权重为1.0和0.2,可选元素为0.1,被排除元素为−0.1-0.1. 完整,部分和弱证据的相应参考质量权重为1.0,0.2和0.1.

blocks.en: Keyframe library and evaluation. StoryMem stores flat keyframe files, retains at most three diverse keyframes per shot under HPSv3 ≥ 3.0 \geq 3.0 and CLIP similarity < 0.9 <0.9 , deduplicates against the complete history, and restricts inference to its Sink–Recent window. In contrast, our library retains up to six diverse keyframes per shot under HPSv3 ≥ 2.5 \geq 2.5 and CLIP similarity < 0.95 <0.95 , only filters near-duplicate adjacent additions, preserves all historical candidates, and attaches VLM element-presence boxes, reference-quality labels, and holistic descriptions. We evaluate all methods using the official EntityBench implementation, replacing its default Gemini judge with Doubao Seed2.1 Turbo uniformly for every method.
blocks.zh: 关键框架库和评价。 故事 Mem存储平面键框文件,在HPSv3 → 3.0\geq 3.0 和 CLIP 相似度 < 0.9<0.9 下最多保留了三种不同的键框,与完整的历史相悖,并限制其Sink - Recent window的推论. 相比之下,我们的图书馆在HPSv3 → 2.5\geq 2.5 和 CLIP 相似度 < 0.95 < 0.95 下保留了最多6个不同的键框,只过滤相邻的相邻的相邻添加,保存了所有历史考生,并附上了VLM元素存在框,参考质量标签和整体描述. 我们利用实体本克的正式执行来评估所有方法,用杜博种子2.1 Turbo统一取代默认的双子座法官。

blocks.en: We compare against seven representative baselines from recent advances in multi-shot video generation, organized into two groups. The first comprises training-based methods with dedicated generation models: CineTrans ( Wu et al. 2025b ) , HoloCine ( Meng et al. 2026 ) , LongLive2.0 ( Chen et al. 2026 ) , and ShotStream ( Luo et al. 2026 ) . The second evaluates explicit reference-construction workflows using the same commercial video API. VideoMemory ( Zhou et al. 2026 ) and ViMax ( Huang et al. 2026 ) first synthesize dedicated reference images and then condition video generation on them, whereas StoryMem ( Zhang et al. 2025 ) and our approach use keyframes mined from generated history. Although the official StoryMem implementation adapts Wan2.2 with LoRA for multi-reference video generation, its memory construction and keyframe-selection procedures are explicit and deterministic. For a fair comparison, our StoryMem reproduction preserves these procedures while replacing the video generator with the same Seedance2.0 backend.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了最近多镜头录像制作工作进展的七个有代表性的基线,分成两组。 第一种方法包括基于培训的方法和专门的生成模型: Cinetrans (Wu等2025b),HoloCine (Meng等2026),LongLive2.0 (Chen等2026),和ShotStream (Loo等2026). 第二部使用相同的商业视频API来评价明确的参考建筑工作流程. VideoMemory (Zhou等2026年)和ViMax (Huang等2026年)首先合成了专用的参考图像,然后在图像上设定视频生成条件,而StoryMem (Zhang等2025年)和我们的方法则使用从生成的历史中挖掘出来的键盘. 虽然官方的StoryMem执行与LORA相适应Wan2.2用于多参考视频生成,但其内存构建和键框选择程序是明确和决定性的. 为了进行公平的比较,我们StoryMem复制保留了这些程序,同时将视频生成器替换为同一种种子2.0后端.

blocks.en: Results
blocks.zh: 结果

blocks.en: Table 1: Cross-Shot Consistency on the same 35-episode EntityBench subset. Overall averages all 21 metrics. Best and second-best results are shown in bold and underlined, respectively.
blocks.zh: 表1:同一35集实体Bench子集上的交叉同步. 总体平均值为所有21个度量。 最佳和次最佳成果分别以粗体和下划线显示。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1 , our method achieves the best Overall score of 0.8670 and leads all three LLM-judged categories, with scores of 0.8930 for character consistency, 0.8780 for object consistency, and 0.8510 for scene consistency. These results demonstrate its effectiveness in preserving diverse recurring visual elements across shots.
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,我们的方法取得了0.8670的最好总分,并领导了所有三个LLM评分类别,性能一致性分数为0.8930分,物体一致性分数为0.8780分,场景一致性分数为0.8510分. 这些结果表明,它有效地保留了各种反复出现的视觉要素。

blocks.en: The results also reveal a metric-dependent pattern. Training-based methods such as LongLive2.0 and ShotStream are particularly competitive in DINOv2 similarity. Their model-internal propagation of history through cross-shot attention, caches, or related memory mechanisms may better preserve embedding-level appearance, and their training objectives may reinforce this effect. However, their lower LLM scores indicate that high feature similarity does not necessarily imply preservation of the correct character attributes, object states, or scene semantics. In contrast, the explicit workflows generally perform better under these fine-grained multimodal judgments, suggesting an advantage from explicitly organizing and grounding historical evidence.
blocks.zh: 结果还揭示出一种依靠衡量的模式。 LongLive2.0和ShotStream等基于培训的方法在DINOv2相似性方面特别有竞争力. 他们通过交叉镜头关注、缓存或相关记忆机制对历史进行模式内部传播,可能更好地保存嵌入层外观,其培训目标可能强化这种效果。 然而,他们较低的LLM分数表明高特征相似性并不一定意味着保留正确的字符属性,对象状态,或场景语义. 与此相反,在这些精细的多式判决下,明确的工作流程一般表现得更好,这表明明确整理历史证据并确立其基础具有优势。

blocks.en: Among methods using the same Seedance2.0 backend, the historical-keyframe approaches, StoryMem and ours, outperform the generated-reference approaches, VideoMemory and ViMax, across all four categories. Dedicated entity images provide clean canonical references but may differ from appearances produced by the video generator and omit useful co-occurrence or scene context. Historical keyframes retain visual evidence from earlier shots, while our annotation, complementary retrieval, and grounded prompting determine what to reuse and suppress.
blocks.zh: 在使用同一种子2.0后端的方法中,历史-关键框架方法StoryMem和我们的,在所有四个类别中都超过了生成的参考方法VideoMemory和ViMax。 专门的实体图像提供了干净的教条参考,但可能不同于视频生成器制作的外观,并省略了有用的相机或场景上下文. 历史的关键框架保留了早期镜头的视觉证据,而我们的注释、补充检索和有根据的提示则决定了重新利用和压制什么。

blocks.en: Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 读取研究

blocks.en: Table 2: Cross-Shot Consistency of ablations and retrieval baselines on the same 35-episode subset.
blocks.zh: 表2:同一35集子集上同调和取回基线的交叉一致。

blocks.en: All variants use the same 35 episodes, generation backend, VLM judge, and animation constraints; variants using references also share the same reference budget of 5 images. Full denotes the complete pipeline. w/o Cover retains visual element planning and grounded prompting but replaces iterative complementary selection with a single-pass Top- K K selection based on the same static element-aware frame scores. w/o Prompting retains visual element planning and greedy coverage but conditions the generator only on the original shot prompt and selected images, omitting structured element plans and reference-specific guidance. CLIP Retrieval keeps the keyframe library and retrieves historical frames using CLIP text–image similarity between the current shot prompt and each candidate frame, without visual element planning, complementary coverage, or reference grounding. No Reference uses only the shot prompt and removes historical visual references entirely.
blocks.zh: 所有变体使用相同的35集,生成后端,VLM评分,以及动画限制;使用引用的变体也共享了5个图像的相同的参考预算. 完全表示整个管道。 (单位:千美元) 封面保留了可视元素规划和被锚定的提示,但根据相同的静态元素意识框架分数,用单通Top-K选择取代了迭代互补选择. w/o Expressing保留了视觉元素的规划和贪婪的覆盖,但仅将生成器条件于原始的镜头即时和所选取的图像上,省去结构化元素的计划和参考特定的指导. 《刑法》 检索保存了密钥框架库,并使用 CLIP 文本搜索历史框架 - 当前镜头快取和每个候选帧的相近性, 不进行视觉元素规划、 补充覆盖, 也不进行参考定位 。 无参考文献只使用射击提示并完全删除历史视觉参考文献.

blocks.en: Table 2 demonstrates that Full yields the highest Overall score and ranks first across all four evaluation criteria. w/o Cover lowers Overall by 0.0188 and degrades every reported metric, confirming that independently high-scoring frames do not necessarily form a complementary reference set. w/o Prompting lowers Overall by 0.0179 and character consistency by 0.0417, indicating that selected images remain ambiguous unless the generator is told which evidence to preserve and which historical content to suppress. CLIP Retrieval trails Full by 0.0214 in Overall and 0.0523 in character consistency. Because it jointly removes element planning, element-aware coverage, and reference grounding, this comparison measures the benefit of the integrated element-aware workflow rather than any single component. Finally, No Reference reduces Overall to 0.5456, demonstrating that text-only prompting is insufficient to preserve recurring entities across independently generated shots.
blocks.zh: 表2显示,Full总得分最高,在所有四项评价标准中排名第一。 w/o 覆盖下 总体而言,比0.0188增加了0.0188分,并降解了每个已报告的度量衡,从而证实独立高分分框不一定构成一个补充参考集. w/o 触发下调 总的来说是0.0179,字符一致性是0.0417,表明所选图像仍然模糊不清,除非告诉生成者哪些证据可以保存,哪些历史内容可以压制. 《刑法》 检索线索 整体上是0.0214,字符一致性是0.0523。 由于它共同消除了元素规划,元素意识覆盖和参考地基,因此这一比较衡量了集成元素意识工作流程而不是任何单一组件的好处. 最后, " 无参考文献 " 将总体减少到0.5456, 表明仅用文字提示不足以保护反复出现的实体,使其保持独立生成的镜头。

blocks.en: Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 定性分析

blocks.en: Figure 2 shows that greedy coverage avoids redundant Top- K K frames by favoring uncovered elements, yielding a complementary set that covers all required content. Figure 3 demonstrates how grounding disambiguates a selected frame: without it, the volcanoes and the rose from the Little Prince’s former planet leak into his visit to a merchant on a new planet. Our method preserves the Little Prince’s appearance while explicitly excluding these obsolete scene elements.
blocks.zh: 图2显示,贪婪的覆盖通过偏好被发现的元素来避免冗余的Top-K框架,产生一个覆盖所有需要内容的补充集. 图3显示地平线是如何使一个选定的框架变得模糊不清的:没有地平线,小王子前星球上的火山和玫瑰就会渗入他拜访新星球上的一位商人。 我们的方法保留了小王子的外表,同时明确排除了这些过时的场景元素.

blocks.en: Figure 4 further compares explicit reference-management workflows under the same Seedance 2.0 backend on the challenging Hard_5 episode. Fiona changes from her green dress into Leo’s smiley-face hoodie in Scene 10, Shot 3 and should retain this outfit thereafter. VideoMemory and ViMax exhibit outfit inconsistency in the later Fiona shot; ViMax also exhibits background drift in the cluttered workshop. StoryMem produces character confusion by rendering Fiona as Leo, followed by character drift for Silas. In contrast, our framework preserves the intended character, outfit, and scene states across the long-range sequence.
blocks.zh: 图4进一步比较了挑战性"Hard_5"剧集同一"种子"2.0后端下的明确参考管理工作流程. 菲奥娜从她的绿色外衣, Video Memory和ViMax在后来的Fiona镜头中表现出了装束的不一致;ViMax在杂乱的作坊中也表现出了背景漂移. 故事 Mem通过将Fiona作为Leo来产生角色混淆,后为Silas出演角色漂移. 反之,我们的框架 保留了预期的性格,服装, 和场景状态 跨长距离序列。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Qualitative comparison of explicit workflows on EntityBench Hard_5 ; all methods use Seedance 2.0. Colored text and boxes identify the relevant characters and scene. After Fiona changes into Leo’s smiley-face hoodie in Scene 10, Shot 3, VideoMemory and ViMax exhibit outfit inconsistency in Scene 26, Shot 3; ViMax also exhibits background drift. StoryMem exhibits character confusion for Fiona and character drift for Silas. Our method preserves the marked character, outfit, and background states.
blocks.zh: 图4:实体Bench Hard_5上明确工作流程的定性比较;所有方法都使用"种子"2.0. 彩色文字和框能识别出相关的字符和场景. 在Fiona改用Leo的笑脸外衣后, 故事 对菲奥娜和Silas的人物迷惑 我们的方法保存了标记的字符,服装, 和背景状态。

blocks.en: Figure 5 visualizes the component effects on Scene 3 of Easy_2 . Removing complementary coverage selection yields an outfit inconsistency for Priya, while removing structured prompting produces character confusion. Replacing element-aware retrieval with generic CLIP retrieval causes clothing drift and removes Priya’s head covering. The complete pipeline maintains both the recurring characters and the Old Quarter scene across the displayed shots.
blocks.zh: 图5可视化了Easy_2第3场的组件效果. 取消补充覆盖选择会导致Priya的布局不一致,同时取消结构化的导出会导致字符混淆。 用通用的CLIP检索取代元素意识检索会导致服装漂移并去掉Priya的头盖. 整个输油管既保留了反复出现的人物,又保留了展出镜头上方的"老区"一幕.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Qualitative ablation on Scene 3 of EntityBench Easy_2 . Without complementary coverage, Priya has an outfit inconsistency in Shot 5. Without structured prompting, Priya is incorrectly generated in Shot 5. CLIP retrieval causes clothing drift and loses her head covering. The complete pipeline maintains the intended character and Old Quarter scene states.
blocks.zh: 图5:实体Bench Easy_2第3场的定性减速. 在没有补充保险的情况下,Priya在Shot 5中有一套不统一的衣服。 在没有结构化的提示的情况下,Priya在Shot 5中生成错误. CLIP检索会导致衣物漂移并失去头部覆盖. 整个输油管保持预定的性能和"老区"的场景状态.

blocks.en: Conclusion
blocks.zh: 结论

blocks.en: We presented Complementary Retrieval-Augmented Prompting, a training-free framework for consistent long-form video generation with frozen short-video generators. Instead of compressing visual history into implicit memory or relying on manually curated references, our framework maintains a text-grounded visual element registry together with a VLM-annotated keyframe library, turning generated history into structured and queryable evidence. Coverage-aware retrieval selects a compact set of complementary frames, while grounded multimodal prompting specifies what each frame should contribute and which stale content should be suppressed. EntityBench experiments demonstrate superior cross-shot consistency, while ablations validate complementary retrieval and reference grounding. Beyond accuracy, the explicit intermediate representations make reference decisions interpretable and editable, supporting interactive creation without a complete script. Separating evidence maintenance, retrieval, and generation also facilitates backend portability and allows failures to be traced to individual pipeline stages rather than hidden within model states. Current limitations include errors in element planning and visual annotation, imperfect prompt adherence by the underlying generator, and constraints imposed by commercial APIs. Future work will improve agentic verification, scale retrieval to longer narratives, and strengthen transfer across video-generation backends and interactive production settings.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了补充检索增强快取,这是使用冷冻短视频发电机的一致长式视频生成的无培训框架。 我们的框架不是将视觉历史压缩为隐含的内存或依赖人工整理的参考文献,而是维持一个以文字为基础的视觉元素登记册和一个VLM-附加说明的密钥框架库,把生成的历史变成结构化和可查询的证据. 了解覆盖面的检索选择一套紧凑的辅助框架,而有根基的多式提示则具体说明每个框架应起到什么作用以及应抑制哪些陈旧的内容。 Entertain Bench实验表现出了优异的交叉射击一致性,而活化验证了互补检索和参考地基. 除了准确性外,明确的中间表示使参考决定可以解释和编辑,支持没有完整脚本的交互式创建. 分离证据的维护、取用和生成也有助于后端可移植性,并允许将故障追踪到单个管道阶段,而不是隐藏在模型状态中。 目前的限制包括元素规划和视觉注释的错误,基础生成器的不完善的即时遵守,以及商业API施加的限制. 今后的工作将改进代理核查,将检索范围扩大到较长的叙述,并加强跨视频生成后端和互动制作环境的传输。
